Readings


A selection of core texts discussed during the lessons and required for the exam. Further references and tools are linked inside each lesson and collected in the Are.na channel.

  • Vinzenz Aubry, ‘In Defense of No Image’, 2024
  • Franco Basaglia (ed.), L’istituzione negata: Rapporto da un ospedale psichiatrico, Einaudi, 1968
  • Jay David Bolter, Diane Gromala, Windows and Mirrors: Interaction Design, Digital Art, and the Myth of Transparency, MIT Press, 2003
  • Geoffrey C. Bowker, Susan Leigh Star, Sorting Things Out: Classification and Its Consequences, MIT Press, 1999
  • Catherine D’Ignazio, Lauren F. Klein, Data Feminism, MIT Press, 2020
  • Johanna Drucker, ‘Humanities Approaches to Interface Theory’, Culture Machine, vol. 12, 2011
  • Alexander R. Galloway, The Interface Effect, Polity, 2012
  • Valeria Graziano, Marcell Mars, Tomislav Medak, Pirate Care: Acts Against the Criminalization of Solidarity, Pluto Press, 2025
  • Joost Grootens, Blind Maps and Blue Dots: The Blurring of the Producer–User Divide in the Production of Visual Information, PhD thesis, Leiden University, 2020
  • Olia Lialina, ‘Once Again, The Doorknob’, 2018
  • Olia Lialina, ‘Turing Complete User’, 2012
  • Shannon Mattern, ‘Maintenance and Care’, Places Journal, 2018
  • Permacomputing, Permacomputing
  • Pirate Care, Pirate Care Syllabus, ongoing
  • Laurel Schwulst, ‘My Website Is a Shifting House Next to a River of Knowledge. What Could Yours Be?’, The Creative Independent, 2018
  • Joan C. Tronto, Moral Boundaries: A Political Argument for an Ethic of Care, Routledge, 1993
  • Mierle Laderman Ukeles, Manifesto for Maintenance Art 1969!, proposal for the exhibition ‘CARE’, 1969
  • Eyal Weizman, Matthew Fuller, Investigative Aesthetics: Conflicts and Commons in the Politics of Truth, Verso, 2021
